welcome.subject: Your epanet-js trial has started
welcome.intro: Thanks for starting your epanet-js trial. You have {{days}} days to try it on your own networks, and there's no card to add.
welcome.firstStep: The best first step is to get your own network in. You can import an EPANET (.inp) file, convert a model from another format, or build a new model from your GIS data with the model builder.
welcome.paidFeatures: Once your model is in, try paid features like scenarios, model validation and running scripts on it. That's where you'll see what epanet-js can really do.
welcome.guides: If you get stuck, our guides walk through each of these step by step.

endingSoon.subject: Your epanet-js trial ends in 3 days
endingSoon.intro: Your epanet-js trial ends in 3 days. To keep using the paid features, choose a plan before then.
endingSoon.keepFeatures: By upgrading, you keep features like scenarios, model validation and running scripts available on your models.
endingSoon.freePlan: If you don't choose one, your account moves to the free plan and the paid features lock.

ended.subject: Your epanet-js trial has ended
ended.intro: Your epanet-js trial has ended, and your account is now on the free plan. Paid features like scenarios, model validation and running scripts are locked.
ended.pickUp: You can pick up where you left off at any time by upgrading.
ended.feedback: If epanet-js wasn't the right fit, I'd love to know why. Just hit reply.
